calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by the relative magnitude of positive versus negative daily-return volatility over the prior 20 completed sessions. Higher values indicate larger upside shocks relative to downside shocks and are expected to rank higher over the 20-session forward horizon.
calculation.timing: Computed after the previous completed daily close; no current or forward observations are used.

validation.regime_notes: Date-aligned cross-sectional Spearman IC across the full synthetic history. The inverted downside-minus-upside diagnostic was evaluated with the same signal artifact; results are positive at the 20-day horizon. Online and recent subperiods are stronger, but uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section contains 15 instruments.

signal_provenance.signal_artifact: The script computes downside-minus-upside; the persisted factor is its exact negative, upside-minus-downside.
signal_provenance.cutoff_rule: Only observations through the prior completed date are used.
